name: ProfilerStreamer_calibrate
description: This component calibrates the transformation from device coordinates to machine coordinates.

inputParameters.name: i_profiler_ip_address
inputParameters.description: The IP address of the profiler device.

inputParameters.name: i_opcua_address
inputParameters.description: The IP address of the OPC UA device followed by the namespace index, for example '192.168.0.64:4840'.

inputParameters.name: i_recording_duration
inputParameters.description: The duration for recording, in seconds.

inputParameters.name: i_trajectory
inputParameters.description: The trajectory for the tool end in the form of a straight line.

inputParameters.name: i_timeout
inputParameters.description: The timeout duration for the rangefinder device, in seconds. If the rangefinder data does not change by 20mm within this duration, the recording will stop.

inputParameters.name: i_slicing_interval
inputParameters.description: The time interval used to detect when the CNC movement starts and stops. 2 seconds is the default value.

inputParameters.name: i_reference_points
inputParameters.description: The reference points in the machine coordinates that correspond to the points that will be selected from the point cloud as part of the calibration process. The order of the reference points should correspond to the order of the points selected from the point cloud.

outputParameters.name: o_calibration_data
outputParameters.description: The calibration data to calibrate the profiler data.

outputParameters.name: o_calibrated_point_cloud
outputParameters.description: The calibrated point cloud of the profiler data, for your info.
